rows.statement: No version-9 search gives the gamma at which an 1850 kg/m3 face floats at concept. The concept float at gamma 0.20 is a face-density result.
The ISA payload at the common TRL 7 gamma factor is a different geometry from the optimistic closure. It is not a same-hull weather result.
Version 9 has no root between gamma 0.20 and 0.6407145989713096. The specification forbids interpolating one.
If the measured equibiaxial factor is below 0.7937005259840998, version 9 has no density. A higher Q at that factor also has no reoptimized root.
The 30 to 90 thousand dollar range is the thin surrogate. A design-gauge shell at the version-9 R/tc, with the production cell, is outside that range. No new price was sought.
Wrinkle wavelength has not been compared with R. The flat-panel factor stops if the wrinkle is long beside R 20 m or R 30 m.
Equation 2.2-15 is not yet a measured allowable for SR-200 on CR-III. These specifications do not make it one.
The model sig0 uses the square-root power. Handbook (4.2-3) uses the one-quarter power. T7's gamma formula must state which power it used.
Cure, gradient, bending and the pressure adder remain QUESTIONABLE inside the margins. Uniaxial term-removal factors are not biaxial sensitivities.
Neither test is authorized. No supplier or test house was contacted.
